tag_evidence.evidence: The report examines evolving consumer behavior and decision-making across 12 countries.

tag_evidence.section_label: Value redefined: where fairness and quality intersect
tag_evidence.evidence: Explores how fairness and quality shape consumer perceptions of value.
Connects careful spending with small indulgences and emotional satisfaction.
Discusses AI-guided shopping, recommendations, and agents that can reduce friction in searching, comparing, and purchasing.
Emphasizes transparent value delivery and responsible AI to earn consumer trust.

tag_evidence.section_label: Reliable tech builds loyalty – but with boundaries
tag_evidence.evidence: Examines how dependable technology and experiences contribute to loyalty, while respecting consumer boundaries.
